output.body:
## Summary

```diff
 MainMenuView
-  paint487 as a background
+  omit nonpainting depth1/clipDepth2 mask
   retain title / control timelines
```

Remove the unintended gray tint and lower-right white outline observed during the original Credits comparison. Original556 places487 as a mask; all manually rendered controls start above its clip range. Builds on merged #35. This extracts an independent correction from the later series-strip backlog.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the native pixel regression fails on the original renderer restored exactly from the parent commit.
  **After:** both empty-region comparisons pass with the mask omitted. Updated native Credits was inspected with the outline absent; retained intro/fades/guard/title179, Back hover and offline feedback still pass.
- The fixture temporarily uses a solid backdrop, compares canvas shown/hidden on the same frozen frame, then restores normal visibility/gradient before navigation. Comparisons stay exact. The first gradient probe exposed compositor dithering (45/200 pixels, maximum one channel value); no tolerance or product color change was added.
- Formatting, TypeScript,454 rule/parser tests /5777 assertions, production build and all four affected native/mock menu/Credits cases pass. Temporary debug attachments were removed.
- Raw SWF placement/shape facts and the preceding original-runtime capture support the correction. No generated data or media changes. Preserve this removal when the series-strip checkpoint lands.
- Shared background/particles, series controls, hit contours, event delivery, global phase and exact filter/text pixels remain separate work. This closes the observed mask-paint defect, not complete menu/game parity.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** rendering

Removes one incorrectly painted native menu object. The retained child timelines and mock layout remain intact.
